notes: Stockroom and punchout pages are not indexed by search. Illumina's own order pages hide prices behind sign-in. Only core-facility rate cards turned up, and the main ones are already in the known list: UConn, Salk and Rutgers. Rutgers is not on the known list, but its PDF could not be read. I found no Fisher, VWR or other distributor pages, and no same-catalog-number price pairs across years. The search results gave catalog numbers that don't match the probe: 20028319 appears to be a 6000 S1 v1.5 kit rather than S4, 20085594 is the X 10B-300 kit, and 20104706 is the X 25B-300 kit. I did not check the catalog numbers on the Illumina pages myself. I did not open the Wayback Machine. I used 4 tool calls.
how_to_mine: Search the S4 and X catalog numbers directly: 20028312/20028313/20028314 (S4 6000 kits), 20085594 (X 10B-300) and 20104706 (X 25B-300). Combine each with 'stockroom', 'punchout', 'Fisher', 'VWR', 'Government Scientific Source' or 'SKU'. Then pull Wayback snapshots of the Salk, UConn Honeycrisp (products/401), MDC Berlin (media/38662, 39029 and 39941 are different price-list versions) and Unifi rate cards. Pair prices by catalog number across dates. MDC Berlin's three versions are the best lead for a dated 6000 S4 time series in EUR.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: Per-Gb price paid for the NovaSeq 6000 S4-300 kit at one university core is still about 2x the X 25B rate at the same core, so no sign the gap is narrowing there.
items.detail: UConn's Center for Genome Innovation rate page (updated Jan 2025, 'current through Feb 2025') lists the NovaSeq 6000 S4 v1.5 300-cycle kit at $16,578 internal contract price, plus 6.5% shipping. At the roughly 3,000 Gb nominal S4 output (my assumption) that is about $5.5/Gb. UConn's X 25B price of about $2.94/Gb is already in the known list. The page shows no earlier 6000 prices, so there is no change over time. Rutgers' 2022 sheet showed S4-300 at $15,230 (from a search snippet; the PDF was unreadable), which would be +8.9% by Feb 2025 across two different institutions. That is a weak comparison.
items.source_name: UConn Center for Genome Innovation service rates
items.why_new: UConn's X 25B price is known; the S4-300 $16,578 and the Rutgers $15,230 (2022) pairing are not in the exclusion list.

new_candidates: MDC Berlin Illumina price lists (mdc-berlin.de/media/38662, /39029, /39941): three versions with the S4 v1.5 300-cycle kit at EUR 14,435.30 in one of them; could give a dated 6000 and X price series in EUR
UConn Honeycrisp core product catalog (honeycrisp.core.uconn.edu/products/401): kit prices by 6-month period (SP 300 $3,649.80 for Jul-Dec 2025), a possible NovaSeq X series by date
Univ. of Florence (unifi.it) 'bio_tariffario_genomica_avanzata.pdf' price list: Italian public-sector NovaSeq pricing, undated in the snippet
